description: Update a Notion database view. Pass at least one update field. Null filter, sorts, or quick_filters values are forwarded to clear those fields.

configuration.description: Raw Notion view configuration payload. Dashboard configuration is rejected.

filter.description: Raw Notion view filter payload, or null to clear

quick_filters.description: Raw Notion quick filters payload, or null to clear

sorts.description: Raw Notion view sorts payload, or null to clear

name: update_view
